tasks.name: todo-module
tasks.content: export function createTodoList(){const items=[];return {add(item){if(!item?.trim())throw new Error('item required');items.push(item);return items.length-1},list(){return [...items]}}}

tasks.name: todo-tests
tasks.content: import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {createTodoList} from '../src/todo.mjs';test('todo list adds and lists in order',()=>{const todos=createTodoList();assert.equal(todos.add('write docs'),0);assert.equal(todos.add('run auto'),1);assert.deepEqual(todos.list(),['write docs','run auto'])});
